name: にぎやかな台所
description: A frying pan is on the kitchen counter. A woman is putting a plate on the table. A girl is sitting on a chair behind the table. A cup is on the table. A man is carrying a box. A dog is running toward a red ball. An apple is in the basket. The basket is next to the kitchen counter.
